fresh_full_claim.policy: A successful execution that does not reproduce the historical T2-D authorisation is a scientific divergence boundary, not an engineering crash. The fresh accepted chain stops and downstream stages must not be represented as fresh reproduction.

archival_continuation.policy: Byte-verified historical accepted parents may be used in a separate retrospective archival profile to audit downstream implementation. This profile is never evidence that the fresh raw-to-science chain reproduced.

t2f_archival_boundary.observed_current_runtime: T2-F formal revisions executed across all 13 targets, then the immutable 2700-row AMW-U exact-parent reproduction assertion failed before T2-F outputs were accepted.
t2f_archival_boundary.policy: Do not delete or relax the exact-parent assertion. For archival downstream implementation audit only, extend the accepted historical parent frontier through Stage T2-F and begin executable continuation at T3-PF.

stage11e.rule: development-training feature standard deviation <= 10*eps(float32) is degenerate and excluded before StandardScaler/logistic fitting
stage11e.status: diagnostic hardening finding; not retroactive recovery of historical T2-D authorisation
